notes.title: The OST is now available, and the game is updated!

notes.title: Launch week is almost over!
notes.content:
And what a ride it was! Thanks everyone for your support, I hope you're enjoying the game. It seems you are and I couldn't be happier.

A handful of news for you:
[list]
[*][b]The Steam Trading Cards have been unlocked[/b]
Some of you might have notice that you unlocked some cards by playing t&T. I had a lot of fun drawing their illustrations and writing their descriptions, I hope you enjoy them (before mercilessly trading them away for material goods).
[*][b]Will the OST be available in mp3 ?[/b]
Funny you should ask, because, as a matter of fact, [b]we will be releasing the OST (along with a few extras) as a DLC some time next week![/b] I've been tirelessly working to remaster it slightly so it fits the soundtrack-format more neatly. So far, it's 25 tracks big and 1h30 hours long!
[*][b]The MacOs release[/b]
I have started to work on it and, while unable to provide you with an ETA, I'm optimistic as it seems the port did [i]not[/i] break everything, as I thought it would. I remain cautious however. Tall-like, if you will.
[*][b]Various small bugs have, as expected, been reported to me.[/b]
I am planning an update to fix all those things. I just need a bit more time as I'm waiting for some last reports on some details.
[/list]

It's been a fantastic week and I'm very pleased by the response the game has met and is meeting.
If any of you is having any difficulty playing the game, don't hesitate to jump on the official forums, which I haunt quite faithfully, and I will do my best to help you out.

Cheers!
pins.
